postgres: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg13+2) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit
build_profile: PostgreSQL release opt-level=3 fat LTO codegen-units=1; direct cargo release
cache_policy: No cache flush; fixture loading and correctness checks precede timing. Direct cohort runs before PostgreSQL cohort. No randomized-order or cold-cache claim.
ttfb: unavailable: published API exposes first decoded batch, not first HTTP byte
clock_contract: Nested/overlapping clocks; never sum or subtract to invent exclusive phases. PG Execution Time includes executor timing overhead. Local recheck time is not instrumented separately.
batch_contract: max_batch_bytes bounds each charged retained batch and its pre-read reservation; client shared retained budget remains 64MiB; no bound on backend RSS. Peak individual charge is not concurrent shared peak.
